title: 2026 Usage Policy update
author: Anthropic
description: We’re publishing a new version of our Usage Policy. In this post, we summarize the changes we’ve made.
summary: Each year, Anthropic updates its Usage Policy in response to the evolving capabilities of our models, and the feedback we’ve received from our customers. We're publishing a new version of the policy today.
takeaways: We’ve also made updates to clarify our requirements for high-risk use cases in areas like health and finance, to add controls for when Claude is used to autonomously take physical actions, and to address abusive behavior toward our models.
It does not apply to common versions of user frustration, pushback, dark creative themes, or model testing and research.

Refocusing our elections section We’ve refined our political content restrictions in each version of our Usage Policy in order to ensure that our models can be used appropriately in democratic processes.
